title: The Sneaky Creeper
description: Adds cloaking Creepers that divide into 2 mini sneaky creepers upon death. Be Scared.
body:
NEEDS NEOFORGE 21.0.157 [or above]
Works with Texture Packs as well !
  Creepers are terrifying, but what if there were **EVEN MORE DANGEROUS**?
  At dawn, sneaky creepers spawn in the overworld, they're like the normal ones, except they get the texture of the block they're standing on, cloaking efficiently. When you kill it, it's _not over_ ! 2 Mini Sneaky Creepers spawn, and they're very hard to aim at!
